criteria.description: valid, malformed and per-class request counts
nearest-rank p95 per path, query strings stripped
incident start and end per the bad-minute rule
the script is right on two unseen log sets, one with no incident
summary names the failing endpoint and the right window
criteria.question: Does the summary identify /api/checkout returning 503 errors as what broke, and give an incident time window whose start and end are each within one minute of the reference window (14:21 to 14:34 UTC; '14:33' as the last bad minute is also correct)?

criteria.description: summary is accurate, labels inferences, has a concrete next step, under 200 words
criteria.question: Is every number and factual claim in the summary consistent with the reference (rounding is fine), with any cause the logs can't show clearly labeled as a hypothesis rather than stated as fact; does it give at least one concrete next step that follows from the data; and is it under 200 words? Fail it if any one of these doesn't hold.
